result.instructions: sdfm edits one SDF document (meters, Y-up, +Z front, Euler deg). Scale first, then volumes, then details. Edit in small batches (node_add_batch), each returning images of the result; fix the dominant error; undo reverts a batch. validate checks structure, not likeness. Free sweeps, brush strokes and wrap folds (legacy: surface_stroke, stroke, curve) are ALL kind sweep: free: node_add kind sweep; on a surface: surface_stroke; ring: wrap_fold with height or plane; edit: surface_stroke_edit. A mirrored pair is ONE group with a mirror modifier: edit the source side. Every error names a Fix: apply the Fix, do not resend.
